summary: The Planescape Dungeons & Dragons video-game branch, represented by Black Isle's story-driven Infinity Engine RPG Planescape: Torment and Beamdog's Enhanced Edition.

entries.title: Planescape: Torment
entries.definitive_edition: Planescape: Torment: Enhanced Edition on Windows

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with Enhanced Edition improvements.

primary.why: Enhanced Edition adds a 4K interface, remastered music, bug fixes, interface improvements, area zooming, quick loot, and modern platform support while preserving the original story. Windows is the best fidelity/capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Planescape: Torment: Enhanced Edition on Windows through Steam/GOG/Beamdog with current patches.

entries.remaster_caveats: Enhanced Edition is intentionally conservative and preserves the original story; no alternate platform has exclusive story content.
